title: Reject exhausted handoff sequences instead of saturating and reusing them
description: NodeRegistry::accept_handoff advances dao_sequence, path_sequence, and OSCORE sender_sequence with saturating_add(1). At the integer maximum this leaves the value unchanged, violating the documented mandatory increment and permitting DAO/path replay or OSCORE nonce reuse after transfer. Validate all transferred sequence counters before mutation and fail the handoff on exhaustion; add boundary tests proving MAX is rejected and MAX-1 advances exactly once.
